The '''Colossal Wyrm Remains''' are the remains of a [[colossal wyrms|colossal wyrm]] that once inhabited the [[Avium Savannah]]. The wyrm was believed to have come from deep within the [[Hailstorm Mountains]] before settling in the Avium Savannah for unknown reasons around 200 years ago.{{CiteText|text=Grand Museum|quote=The wyrm is believed to have originated from deep within the Hailstorm Mountains, but for unknown reasons, it travelled to the Avium Savannah around 200 years ago.}} Terrorising the savannah, warriors from across the kingdom banded together to defeat it,{{CiteText|text=Grand Museum|quote=The wyrm terrorised the region for many moons before warriors from across the kingdom finally banded together to defeat it.}} with the help of an adventurer from [[Hosidius]] during the [[War of the Five Houses]].{{CiteText|text=Bloody diary|quote=In my travels throughout the Shining Kingdom, I have bested many mighty creatures. From the Colossal Wyrm of the Avium Savannah to the Cloud Titan of Tempestus, I am proud to proclaim myself as a master slayer.}} It remains today as a famous landmark in [[Varlamore]], found at the southern end of the savannah; one of its [[Fang of the Colossal Wyrm|fangs]] is also on display on the top floor of the [[Grand Museum]].

In recent years, the remains have fell victim to a termite infestation that is threatening the structure's integrity; thus, the museum has sent [[Worm Tongue]] and [[Construction Worker]]s to lead the preservation effort. The scaffolding around the remains serve as an [[Colossal Wyrm Agility Course|agility course]] in which players help Worm Tongue scoop up [[termites]] around the course for him to eat in exchange for [[Worm Tongue's Wares|rewards]].

Many items are scattered around the remains:

* 8 [[Bones]] (2 requiring [[Telekinetic Grab]])
* 5 [[Big bones]] (1 requiring Telekinetic Grab)
* 1 [[Bucket]]
* 1 [[Hammer]]
* 2 [[Plank]]
* 1 [[Jug of water]] on the advanced side of the agility course
* 1 [[Steel arrow]] on the advanced side of the agility course
* 1 [[Rotten tomato]] on the advanced side of the agility course

==Trivia==
* The remains were originally slated to be accompanied by the agility course upon the release of Varlamore on 20 March 2024, but was delayed to be released alongside the second part on 25 September due to time constraints.
* The corpse of the Colossal Wyrm was originally inspired by player ''Spineweilder'' and their winning submission to the [[Song of the Elves]] lore writing competition, hosted by [[Mod Wolf|Mod Wolf]]. The story, now found in the [[Bloody diary]], is written by an adventurer who helped slay the creature.
* Long, thin shapes can be seen outlined in the [[Wyrm's Waters]] off the nearby coast. Given the area's name and its close proximity to the Colossal Wyrm Remains, these outlines may be the submerged remains of other colossal wyrms.
